_comment: TeleDirectMD physician state medical licenses. Single source of truth for Physician.hasCredential JSON-LD across all state-specific pages. Add new states here when license is issued. Empty entries are intentionally blank — page-level code falls back to generic 'Licensed in <state>' without a credential identifier when no number is present.

vt.credentialDisplayLong: Vermont Medical License (issued by Vermont Board of Medical Practice)

fl.credentialDisplayLong: Florida Out-of-State Telehealth Provider Registration (under Fla. Stat. § 456.47(4))
fl.notes: Out-of-state telehealth provider registration. NOT a full Florida medical license. Dr. Bhavsar holds a Georgia medical license; this registration permits telehealth practice with Florida patients per §456.47. Does not expire or require renewal per FL DOH record.
